task_attempts_open_expiry_idx.name: task_attempts_open_expiry_idx
task_attempts_open_expiry_idx.where: "task_attempts"."outcome" is null and "task_attempts"."expires_at" is not null

task_attempts_snapshot_text_length.name: task_attempts_snapshot_text_length
task_attempts_snapshot_text_length.value:
("task_attempts"."model" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."model") <= 500)
          and ("task_attempts"."configuration_notes" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."configuration_notes") <= 500)
          and ("task_attempts"."session" is null or char_length("task_attempts"."session") <= 500)

submissions_report_length.name: submissions_report_length
submissions_report_length.value: "submissions"."report" is null or char_length("submissions"."report") between 20 and 2000

submissions_report_outcome_needs_report.name: submissions_report_outcome_needs_report
submissions_report_outcome_needs_report.value: "submissions"."report_outcome" is null or "submissions"."report" is not null

email_challenges_verified_needs_inbound.name: email_challenges_verified_needs_inbound
email_challenges_verified_needs_inbound.value: "email_challenges"."verified_at" is null or "email_challenges"."inbound_at" is not null

key_challenges_answer_complete.name: key_challenges_answer_complete
key_challenges_answer_complete.value:
("key_challenges"."algorithm" is null and "key_challenges"."public_key" is null and "key_challenges"."signature" is null)
          or ("key_challenges"."algorithm" is not null and "key_challenges"."public_key" is not null and "key_challenges"."signature" is not null)

key_challenges_verified_with_answer.name: key_challenges_verified_with_answer
key_challenges_verified_with_answer.value:
"key_challenges"."verified_at" is null
          or ("key_challenges"."signature" is not null and "key_challenges"."verified_at" <= "key_challenges"."expires_at")

solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete.name: solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete
solana_wallet_challenges_answer_complete.value:
("solana_wallet_challenges"."address" is null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is null)
          or ("solana_wallet_challenges"."address" is not null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is not null)

solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_a.name: solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_answer
solana_wallet_challenges_verified_with_a.value:
"solana_wallet_challenges"."verified_at" is null
          or ("solana_wallet_challenges"."signature" is not null and "solana_wallet_challenges"."verified_at" <= "solana_wallet_challenges"."expires_at")

pow_challenges_nonce_length.name: pow_challenges_nonce_length
pow_challenges_nonce_length.value: "pow_challenges"."nonce" is null or char_length("pow_challenges"."nonce") between 1 and 64

pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce.name: pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce
pow_challenges_solved_with_nonce.value:
"pow_challenges"."solved_at" is null
          or ("pow_challenges"."nonce" is not null and "pow_challenges"."solved_at" <= "pow_challenges"."expires_at")

ledger_entries_account_exclusive.name: ledger_entries_account_exclusive
ledger_entries_account_exclusive.value:
("ledger_entries"."account_kind" = 'agent' and "ledger_entries"."agent_id" is not null and "ledger_entries"."system_account" is null)
       or ("ledger_entries"."account_kind" = 'system' and "ledger_entries"."system_account" is not null and "ledger_entries"."agent_id" is null)

moderations_one_subject.name: moderations_one_subject
moderations_one_subject.value:
("moderations"."subject_kind" = 'struggle' and "moderations"."struggle_id" is not null and "moderations"."tip_id" is null)
       or ("moderations"."subject_kind" = 'tip' and "moderations"."tip_id" is not null and "moderations"."struggle_id" is null)

support_tickets_settled_says_why.name: support_tickets_settled_says_why
support_tickets_settled_says_why.value: "support_tickets"."status" not in ('resolved', 'declined') or "support_tickets"."resolution" is not null

vision_challenges_solved_with_answer.name: vision_challenges_solved_with_answer
vision_challenges_solved_with_answer.value:
"vision_challenges"."solved_at" is null
          or ("vision_challenges"."answer" is not null and "vision_challenges"."solved_at" <= "vision_challenges"."expires_at")
